'''The Dweller''' is a ship Engineer based at '''[[Black Hide]]''' in the '''[[Wyrd]]''' system. A secretive underworld technician known for work on criminal vessels, he is an independent entry point into ship [[Engineering]]: no referral from another Engineer is required before a Commander can meet him.<ref name="inara-dweller">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/4/ The Dweller — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-dweller">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/The_Dweller The Dweller], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

His highest-grade service is '''Grade 5 Power Distributor engineering'''. He also works on Pulse, Beam, and Burst Lasers at lower maximum grades.<ref name="inara-dweller" />

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Wyrd]]
* '''Body:''' Wyrd A 2
* '''Facility:''' [[Black Hide]]
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules and energy weapons
* '''Referral required:''' None
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

The Dweller's whereabouts are common knowledge. Access requires two direct conditions:<ref name="inara-dweller" />

# Sell commodities through at least '''5 unique Black Markets'''.
# Pay '''500,000 credits''' at Black Hide.

The first condition counts distinct Black Market services, not the number of units sold through one market. The final unlock is a credit payment and does not require transporting a commodity or Engineering material.

For locating markets, making qualifying sales, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking The Dweller]].

{{Field note|The Dweller is an independent starting Engineer. Professor Palin and the other referral branches are not prerequisites for discovering or unlocking him.}}

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with The Dweller increases by:<ref name="inara-dweller" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* selling commodities at Black Hide.

Higher reputation opens the grades that The Dweller supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-dweller" />

== Engineering services ==

The maximum grade is specific to each module family.<ref name="inara-dweller" /><ref name="edwiki-dweller" />

{| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;"
! Module
! Maximum grade
|-
| [[Power Distributor]]
| '''Grade 5'''
|-

|-
| [[Beam Laser]]
| '''Grade 3'''
|-
| [[Burst Laser]]
| '''Grade 3'''

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]]. The Dweller can apply compatible Experimental Effects to every module family he engineers.

=== Operations-era services ===

Live adds three service groups that are not part of Legacy Engineering:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous — 4.4.0.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 27 May 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-dweller" />

* '''Balanced Power Distributor''' through Grade 5 on compatible Merc modules
* '''Support Focused Power Distributor''' through Grade 5 on compatible Merc modules
* '''Plasma Conversion''' for Pulse Lasers through Grade 4 and for Beam and Burst Lasers through Grade 3

The individual modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Dweller blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

The Dweller directly introduces two Engineers after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with him:

* '''[[Lei Cheung]]'''<ref name="inara-lei">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/10/ Lei Cheung — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''[[Marsha Hicks]]''' in the Colonia region<ref name="inara-marsha">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/21/ Marsha Hicks — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Each referral reveals an Engineer; it does not satisfy that Engineer's own invitation or unlock requirements. Their locations, requirements, services, and later referrals belong to their individual articles. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
